description: Polytoria, a multiplayer gaming platform built with Godot and .NET

latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Reduce Dev Build time by @maji-git in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1389
* Add `ShouldReplicate` check in `NetworkScriptSync.NetReqSource` by @arlocomotive in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1387
* Fix typo in LuauProvider.cs by @luuuuuu-W6us in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1366
* Optimize datamodel naming, reflection and animation handling by @hiRemy in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1394
* Improve `Instance.LuaPath` by @arlocomotive in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1326
* Improve `NPC.TryStepUp` by @arlocomotive in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1357
* some new fonts by @chevalyer in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1380
* Add Light Projectors by @maji-git in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1392
* Add Texture Property in PTMeshAsset by @zebraKat in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1395
* Add "(Disabled)" to scripts that have IsEnabled set to False by @RizonFTW in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1159
* Add shapecasting by @arlocomotive in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1305
* Fix `print`/`warn` by @arlocomotive in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1270
* add Visible property to `Marker3D` for use outside of creator by @white-moon-code in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1145
* Set `default_linear_damp` and `default_angular_damp` to 0 by @arlocomotive in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1374
* Rework usages of `PeerPreInit` by @arlocomotive in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1437
* [Bugfix]: Fixed MemoryPack Exception & Refactor by @Marvin-T-S in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1423
* Implement UITextInput:Unfocus() by @zebraKat in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1403
* Improve mobile UI, navigation, and touch controls by @hiRemy in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1375
* Fix physical key detection and improve gamepad input handling by @hiRemy in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1445
* Rework interaction prompts and add mobile support to them by @hiRemy in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1446
* fix multiselect locked bug by @hiRemy in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1447
* Prevent crashes when loading meshes with missing texture metadata by @hiRemy in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1449
* Add trust capabilities to HttpService for increased ratelimits by @retrievaaaa in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/498
* Fix PlayAnimation not working on server by @hiRemy in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1453
* Fix Truss instances initializing with the wrong shape by @chevalyer in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1430
* Overhaul Luau runtime and optimize script execution by @hiRemy in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1459
* Fix item duplication on respawning  by @white-moon-code in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1424
* Fix rendering of negative scaled meshes by @hiRemy in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1460
* Add FromID method to audio, image, mesh, and mesh animation assets by @BadHope3 in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1426
* Fix some replication, physics, lighting and UI issues by @hiRemy in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1461
* Improve netcode and object cleanup by @hiRemy in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1469

## New Contributors
* @chevalyer made their first contribution in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1380
* @RizonFTW made their first contribution in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1159
* @BadHope3 made their first contribution in https://github.com/Polytoria/polytoria-game/pull/1426

**Full Changelog**: https://gith

detail.readme: # Polytoria [![License: MPL 2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MPL_2.0-brightgreen.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MPL-2.0) [![Godot Engine](https://img.shields.io/badge/Godot-4.7-blue?logo=godot-engine)](https://godotengine.org/) [![.NET](https://img.shields.io/badge/.NET-10-purple?logo=dotnet)](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/) Polytoria is a 3D multiplayer gaming platform built on top of the [Godot Engine](https://godotengine.org/). It provides a set of tools for creating your multiplayer games, with server-client architecture, synchronized state replication and scripting powered by [Luau](https://luau.org/). Worlds can be published to [polytoria.com](http://polytoria.com/), which is accessible from Windows, macOS and Linux, with mobile in the works! ![15 Seconds by phoe](docs/creator.png) *Photo credit: [15 Seconds by phoe](https://polytoria.com/places/12661)* ## Getting the Software You can head to [polytoria.com](https://polytoria.com/) to register your account. The download button will be available in the [worlds](https://polytoria.com/places) page. To launch the creator software, head to [polytoria.com/create](https://polytoria.com/create/) and click "Launch Creator". ## Contributing Contributing guides are currently a work in progress. Meanwhile, you can join the [Polytoria Contributors](https://discord.gg/HUgEE9FhSU) Discord server if you have any questions! ## License Unless otherwise noted: - Source code is licensed under Mozilla Public License Version 2.0. Please check [LICENSE](/LICENSE) for more info. - Brand assets, logos, names, and trademarks are not licensed for reuse. - Third-party assets and native binaries are governed by their own licenses. Please refer to the respective repositories and documentation for more information. ## Contributors Made with [contrib.rocks](https://contrib.rocks).
